analysis:
Reviewed both primary analyses and independently checked the replayed patches. .github/workflows/ci.yml:43-47 replaces the five-job provider lane with five one-job lanes; :143 selects a lane using the matrix shard. Total requested capacity remains five Macs, but shards can now independently use Sandbox or fallback runners. docs/developer/build.md:239-246,259-262 documents the matching keys and whole-lane allocation contract. The changes are consistent across these files and do not visibly change permissions, signing/publication, test acceptance, provider authorization, encryption, prompt handling, cache isolation or billing. Existing Sandbox execution is not a newly introduced trust boundary. No independently supported security regression or material threat-model gap was identified; CI execution does not establish A-017 qualification or TB-011/T-054 serving eligibility.
The local reviews' remaining routing question cannot be resolved from this replay: .github/workflows/darkbloom-route.yml and its allocator/tests are not supplied. Verify that they accept and return all five keys, independently reserve capacity without cross-shard collisions, and preserve fallback and runner-isolation behavior under partial grants. This is an unverified integration contract, not evidence of a missing control. Replay is incomplete (four source units omitted), so surrounding gate and isolation claims in the prior analyses could not all be independently rechecked. No production-runtime or deployment conclusion follows from this scoped review.
